heading: Asian Games Medal Tally: Where India stands after 4 more medals as China dominate
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: India added four more medals on Day 2 of the Asian Games 2026 to take its tally to six, with shooting contributing three and Suchika Tariyal creating history with India’s first MMA medal. China continued to dominate Aichi-Nagoya, extending its lead at the top of the standings as the medal race takes shape.
